# Review Examples: Good vs Needs Work (v1.2)
> Generated: 2026-06-22 (audited) | Author: mbaetiong  
🧠 Roles: [Primary: Reviewer], [Secondary: Author] ⚡ Energy: 5

Examples

| Aspect | Good | Needs Work |
|---|---|---|
| Title | Correct emoji + UTC | Missing UTC or wrong title |
| Findings | Severity/Confidence present | Missing scores |
| Patches | Diff with rollback | No rollback plan |
| Schema | Results with remediation | No mention of failures |
| Security | Patterns listed | Vague or missing |
